services.name: carbonio-docs-editor
services.comment: The HCL is generated from the template of the package by the setup step docs-editor, with the identifier of this node in its metadata, and the router and resolver are written once the service is registered.

services.name: carbonio-preview
services.comment: The configuration migration is the --setup of carbonio-preview-bin, run with the token of the service in SETUP_CONSUL_TOKEN; the extra rules are the keys it moves.

services.name: carbonio-prometheus
services.comment: Besides reading the catalog to find what to scrape, prometheus registers itself: that is the extra rule. Its configuration files carry its token, so they are updated when the token is renewed.

services.name: carbonio-prometheus-alertmanager
services.comment: The setup stores the configuration of the package in carbonio-alertmanager/config and renders alertmanager.yml from it: that is the key rule.

services.name: carbonio-prometheus-blackbox-exporter
services.comment: Exporter run as the user carbonio-prometheus, shared by all the prometheus packages: an identity of its own limits what its token can do in Consul (it registers this service only), not what the process can do on the machine.

services.name: carbonio-turn-server
services.comment: carbonio-turn-server-configs-hcl produces the HCL files of both turn-server and turn-server-auth, which the same package setup sets up.

services.name: carbonio-videorecorder
services.comment: The HCL is rendered from the template of the package with the identifier videoserver published for this node, so the role may read carbonio-videoserver/meta/.
